description: This Java source file defines the class AndroidResourceReferenceBase, which extends PsiReferenceBase.Poly<XmlElement>. It provides functionality for resolving and handling references to Android resources within the IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment, including methods for resolving target elements, checking reference validity, and managing resource-related data.

classes.name: AndroidResourceReferenceBase
classes.description: A class that provides reference resolution and resource management functionalities for Android resources within the IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment.

methods.name: AndroidResourceReferenceBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing the reference with resource value, range, and Android facet context.

methods.name: bindToElement
methods.description: Attempts to bind the reference to a new element; currently returns null.

methods.name: computeTargetElements
methods.description: Resolves and returns the target PsiElements this reference points to.

methods.name: multiResolve
methods.description: Performs multi-resolution of the reference, utilizing caching.

methods.name: resolveInner
methods.description: Internal method to resolve resource references, including fallback to app resources.

methods.name: collectTargets
methods.description: Collects potential target resource elements based on resource type and name.

methods.description: Checks if the reference points to a given PsiElement.
